notes.title: SciGirl: The Internship Demo
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are taking part in the Steam Game Festival from Feb. 3rd to 9th with a free demo from our upcoming game SciGirl: The Internship! 
As part of the event, we will be playing our demo and talking about the game's development process and answer questions from the chat. 

The Sindex team.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/broadcast/watch/76561199084514723]SciGirl: The Internship Demo[/url]
